source.title: The periaqueductal gray and Bayesian integration in placebo analgesia.

confidence_rationale: Shows that the precision of a harm-relevant expectation (expected pain relief), not just its magnitude, is represented and used: placebo effects scaled with the relative precision of the prior, with neural correlates in PAG and RVM. This is the 'reliability is attached to the predicted-harm magnitude and is used' half of MECH-585. Capped at 0.55 because the precision is the subject's own belief precision about a treatment, measured by rating spread, not a calibrated estimate of a forward model's error, and the site is brainstem rather than insula/ACC.
failure_signatures: Precision was estimated from the spread of expectation ratings; subjective belief precision can be miscalibrated, so 'precision is used' does not imply 'calibrated reliability is used'.
Placebo paradigm: prior precision weights perception, not the attribution of a PE to world versus model.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Expectations (prior) and nociceptive input (likelihood) are combined weighted by their relative precision; subjects with more precise treatment expectations showed larger placebo hypoalgesia, and prior precision had neural correlates in PAG and RVM.
mapping.ree_translation: A harm-stream prediction carries its own precision, separate from its magnitude, and that precision sets how much the prediction versus the incoming signal governs the outcome. This backs MECH-585's requirement that the harm PE be weighted by the harm predictor's own precision rather than one borrowed from another stream.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Precision here is prior belief precision, not a per-state calibrated expected error of a learned model, and it modulates perception rather than error attribution. No competence floor. Anatomy is PAG/RVM, not the dACC consumer named in the claim.
mapping.source_context: fMRI with heat pain and a placebo manipulation in 62 healthy subjects; Bayesian model with prior and likelihood precision.

confidence_components.notes: Stream-specific precision is the near-literal match; the calibration and attribution parts of the claim are not tested.
